title: VS-107 — Focused Home, Discover, Content and Campaign V2 Integration

notes: Reframes Home around one next creation action.
Connects the isolated v2 Home to existing Brand-scoped recommendations, simple creation and continuation contracts.
Reuses the approved provider-neutral OIDC flow on the v2 hostname without changing identity-provider policy.
Adds the approved v2 Discover collection and Discover Preview using existing Brand-scoped Opportunity contracts.
Adds the approved v2 Content List and Content Preview using existing Brand-scoped Campaign, Content Asset, review and calendar contracts.
Adds the approved v2 Campaign List and Campaign Preview using the same Brand-scoped Campaign, Content Asset, review and calendar contracts.
Does not change Hunter algorithms, API contracts, providers, publishing authority or autonomous scheduling.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner approved Home, Discover, the dual Grid/Table listing standard, Content List and Preview, and Campaign List and Preview in the isolated v2 app.
The existing approved OIDC provider and API contracts are reused; no new provider, data authority or publishing capability is introduced.
Product Owner explicitly approved implementing the shared detailed Table and visual Grid standard, Content List and Preview, and Campaign List and Preview in v2.
Certification requires Product Owner approval bound to the new exact candidate SHA after all repository gates pass.
Release requires a newly certified exact SHA and explicit merge approval.
